verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's own CLI and API can create and delete database branches programmatically, which a CI pipeline could script, and branches are positioned as working like code branches. However, no first-party per-pull-request automation is documented: no CI action, deploy-platform integration, or automatic teardown on PR close. The per-PR lifecycle has to be wired up by the user. Missing for 10: documented per-PR branch automation, CI/deploy-platform integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or a deploy hook), automatic teardown on merge/close, and hands-on corroboration of CI-driven branch lifecycles.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can create and tear down per-pull-request database branches automatically from CI or my deploy platform

citations.quote: Create, delete and list your Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches
The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
PlanetScale allows you to branch database schemas the same way you branch your code.
Branches on PlanetScale Postgres are isolated database deployments that provide you with separate environments for development and testing
It will give you a database branch for each Git branch and help you manage the workflows around it.
